parameters.description:
`msg-to-simplepush` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your SimplePush destination — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own SimplePush destinations — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional SimplePush destinations bound per enrollment.

Install the SimplePush app on your Android device and sign in (or create an account) — your personal API key is shown on the app's main screen. Set it as SIMPLEPUSH_APIKEY; UnitySVC then pushes each message straight to whichever devices are signed into that SimplePush account.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment SimplePush destinations, direct
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own SimplePush destination by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

api_key.description: This enrollment's SimplePush apikey. Paste it or pick one of your secrets; it is kept as a secret and not shown again.
